nights.title: Negroni Night
nights.note: The Negroni family, start to finish — Martini bookends, three amaro/vermouth takes on the classic, close variants, weirder builds, a couple of wild cards, and a chocolate close.

cocktails.name: 15:1 Dry Martini (Montgomery)
cocktails.description: 75ml gin, 5ml dry vermouth. Named for Field Marshal Montgomery, who reportedly wouldn't attack without 15-to-1 odds.

cocktails.name: Negroni with Campari
cocktails.description: The classic: 30ml gin, 30ml Campari, 30ml sweet vermouth.

cocktails.name: Negroni with Select
cocktails.description: The Venetian classic: 30ml gin, 30ml Select Aperitivo, 30ml sweet vermouth. Select is the Venice-born bitter liqueur (1920) some regard as the original Negroni-family amaro; lighter and more floral than Campari.

cocktails.name: Negroni with Carpano Antica
cocktails.description: 30ml gin, 30ml Campari, 30ml Carpano Antica Formula vermouth in place of standard sweet vermouth. Carpano Antica is a richer, vanilla-forward premium vermouth.

cocktails.name: Kingston Negroni
cocktails.description: Rum swap: 30ml overproof aged pot-still rum (high-ester Jamaican style, 4–6yrs), 30ml sweet vermouth, 30ml Campari.

cocktails.name: Negroni Sbagliato
cocktails.description: 30ml Campari, 30ml sweet vermouth, 60ml prosecco instead of gin.

cocktails.name: White Negroni
cocktails.description: Gin, gentian liqueur (Suze/Avèze/Salers) and Lillet Blanc instead of Campari and sweet vermouth: 30ml each.

cocktails.name: Eeyore's Requiem
cocktails.description: 45ml Campari, 30ml bianco vermouth, 20ml gin, 7.5ml Cynar, 7.5ml Fernet Branca, 2 dashes orange bitters.

cocktails.name: Comte de Sureau
cocktails.description: 45ml gin, 25ml elderflower liqueur (St-Germain), 7.5ml Campari. The "Elderflower Negroni."

cocktails.name: Mulled Negroni
cocktails.description: 25ml gin, 25ml Campari, 25ml sweet vermouth, 15ml claret, 10ml falernum, 5ml sloe gin.

cocktails.name: Blue Negroni
cocktails.description: 30ml Old Tom gin, 20ml Luxardo Bitter Bianco, 20ml bianco vermouth, 10ml dry vermouth, 10ml blue curaçao, 3 drops saline solution.

cocktails.name: End of the Road
cocktails.description: 30ml peated single malt whisky, 30ml Green Chartreuse, 30ml Campari. No vermouth. Served up in a chilled coupe. Diffords calls it "punchy, Negroni-esque" rather than a formal variant.

cocktails.name: Chocolate Negroni
cocktails.description: 30ml gin, 22.5ml Punt e Mes, 22.5ml Campari, 7.5ml white crème de cacao, 6 drops chocolate bitters.

cocktails.name: Sour Cherry Negroni
cocktails.description: 30ml gin, 22.5ml Campari, 22.5ml sweet vermouth (Martini & Rossi Riserva Speciale Rubino), 15ml crème de noyaux, 5ml acid-adjusted cherry juice, dash of saline solution (10:1 water to salt). From Hawksmoor NYC.
